description: A faint NW–SE–oriented linear ridge–ditch feature ~2–3 m wide and ~220 m long, showing alternating convex–concave curvature on the LiDAR hillshade and a persistent low-NIR signature consistent with a compacted earthen causeway or buried canal on a <2° interfluve slope.

A small cluster of three parallel raised platforms, each ~3 m wide by ~150 m long and spaced ~80 m apart. They appear as rectilinear positive‐relief bands in the curvature derivative and coincide with localized high-NIR reflectance zones indicative of water-retentive anthropogenic soils (terra preta‐like signatures).
